scope: M10 Final replacement-long failure Diagnostic 2: discriminate SupervisoryAutomatic authority suppression from M7.6-style Assisted coordinated 5-to-10 MWe manoeuvres on authoritative exact-v9
decision_rule: Compare the SupervisoryAutomatic rod probe against the frozen load-only reference instead of assuming suppression. If its rod command has no material physical effect and it reproduces the frozen loss-of-synchronism path while one or more Assisted coordinated probes materially delay or avoid the trip, classify the frozen replacement operator/authority policy as under-specified relative to M7.6. If a bounded Assisted probe reaches a late stable 10 MWe window, use it only as evidence for a separate revised workload/operator-policy candidate and new replacement-long freeze. If no Assisted coordinated probe improves margin, retain the workload and continue production transient/control-granularity diagnosis. Protection retuning is not authorized by this diagnostic.
